name: hk_no2_pm25_traffic_dominance
requirements: Compare roadside enhancement for NO2 vs PM2.5, then examine rush hour effect. Please store the results in: no2_roadside_general_ratio (float, 2dp), pm25_roadside_general_ratio (float, 2dp), more_traffic_dominated (str), rush_no2_pm25_ratio (float, 2dp), offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio (float, 2dp).

turns.query: In October 2025, compute the ratio of average NO2 at roadside stations to average NO2 at general stations, and the same ratio for PM2.5. A higher roadside-to-general ratio indicates stronger local traffic source contribution. Which pollutant shows a larger roadside enhancement, indicating it is more dominated by local traffic sources? Return both ratios rounded to 2 decimal places and the more traffic-dominated pollutant name.

For roadside stations in October 2025, compute the average NO2 to PM2.5 concentration ratio during rush hours (08:00-09:00, 17:00-19:00) versus off-peak hours (00:00-05:00, 10:00-15:00). A higher ratio during rush hours would confirm that traffic peaks disproportionately elevate NO2 relative to PM2.5. Return both ratios rounded to 2 decimal places.
